	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = assay_district_01

		}

	else_if = {
		limit = {

			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = district_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = assay_district_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = assay_district_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = district_tier_3_cost }
		}

	else_if = {
